scope: pi0.5 RECAP adaptation; not a full pi*0.6 reproduction

sft.source: all four standard no_noops datasets; no additional filtering

sampling.within_group: uniform task, then uniform frame; demo and rollout pooled

recap.pool: all demos + all shared R1 autonomous + this branch's R2 autonomous

initialization.actor_warm_start: same seed selected previous-stage EMA; optimizer/schedule/EMA reinitialized
initialization.critic: same seed-specific pretrained backbone and fresh new layers every round

labels.positive_rule: per-task percentile70 of all autonomous frames, A >= threshold; ties retained
labels.experts: demo/intervention always positive, excluded from percentile
labels.relabel: all accumulated autonomous episodes with latest selected critic

evaluation.sft_selection: 40 tasks x 50 official init states x 1 dev group
evaluation.recap_selection: 10 Long tasks x 50 official init states x 1 dev group
evaluation.final: 10 Long tasks x 50 official init states x 3 eval groups
evaluation.critic_metric: task-macro CE on independent development episodes; ties earliest updates
evaluation.critic_validation: R1: selected SFT Long dev; R2: SFT Long dev + own selected R1 Long dev
evaluation.final_statistics: average 3 eval groups per trained seed, then mean and sample SD of 3 trained seeds

deployment.formal_training: single node, one JAX process, 8 A800-80G

status: Implementation in progress; not a declaration of completed audits or experiments
